headline: Bank credit in Morocco: diaspora efforts will now be able to help their relatives
summary: Money sent by Moroccans abroad to their families equalled 8% of Moroccan GDP in 2024, according to IFAD figures. Diaspora efforts will now be able to help relatives through bank credit.
why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency and household income for Morocco, supporting consumption and the banking sector's lending.
